title: feat(core)!: retire validation-engine.js and its four exports (objectui#7659)
body:
Fixes #7659
Clause-②: yes — public exports of `@object-ui/core` are removed

## What this is

Executes maintainer ruling A on the card (decision batch #40, item 4, recorded in card comment 5548579814): `validation-engine.js` and its four exports (`ValidationEngine`, `defaultValidationEngine`, `validate`, `validateFields`) are removed from `@object-ui/core` under ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. The #3110 carve-out sentence in `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts` no longer names the module as a kept member; it still covers `schema-validator.js`.

⚠️ This is a breaking narrowing of a published package's exports. The seat applied `needs:contract-review` and removes it at landing after a contract-review PASS; the dev writes no label.

## Changes

| file | change |
|---|---|
| `packages/core/src/validation/validation-engine.ts` | deleted |
| `packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/validation-engine.test.ts` and `validation-engine.displayLocale-9909.test.ts` | deleted with it (the engine's own tests) |
| `packages/core/src/validation/index.ts` | export line removed; carve-out rewritten; the docblock's opening label `Phase 3.5: Validation engine` now reads `Phase 3.5: Validation module` (the docblock ships verbatim in `dist/validation/index.d.ts`) |
| `packages/core/src/validation/__tests__/validation-engine-retired-7659.test.ts` | new barrel-absence pin |
| `.changeset/7659-retire-validation-engine.md` | `'@object-ui/core': minor`, BREAKING banner naming the four exports, replacement `buildValidationRules` (`@object-ui/fields`), out-of-repo consumers NOT MEASURED |
| `.changeset/6342-dead-migration-guide-pointers.md`, `.changeset/9909-machine-locale-sweep.md` | the falsified sentence is scoped "At this change" and carries a dated note; front matter md5 identical before and after (`291f1f84…`, `c9e77b57…`) |
| `content/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md` | section 5 named the removed class; it now names `validateSchema` / `assertValidSchema` |
| `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts` | `ValidationContext.locale` doc comment rewritten, because it explained the member by the removed engine (comment only) |
| `packages/plugin-timeline/src/renderer.tsx` | the `instanceof Date` idiom pointer named the deleted file and `data-table.tsx`, which holds no `instanceof Date` since `4758b33c2` (objectui#10625); it now points at `toDay` in `components/src/renderers/form/calendar.tsx` (comment only) |

### File-surface note for the seat

The last two rows are outside the claim's declared file surface. Both are source comments this deletion makes false: one pointed at the deleted path, the other explains a member by "the engine is a plain class with no hook to read". The os-dev role file requires fixing what the change falsifies, and the claim says to stop on a breach. The two conflict, so I followed the role file and declared it here; the seat ruled to keep both (option A). The renderer comment now points at the idiom's live home, `toDay` in `calendar.tsx`: its other pointer, `data-table.tsx`, holds no `instanceof Date` since `4758b33c2`. Both edits are comment-only: eslint warning counts are the same as on the base files (14 and 44), re-read on `renderer.tsx` after the repointing.

## Premise, re-measured at `origin/main` `bc97f9247`

- `validation-engine.ts` exports exactly four names (`export class ValidationEngine`, `export const defaultValidationEngine`, `export async function validate`, `export async function validateFields`). `validation/index.ts` re-exported them with `export * from './validation-engine.js'`, and `packages/core/src/index.ts` re-exports `./validation/index.js`.
- Production consumers across the whole tree (`packages/`, `apps/`, `examples/`, docs): **zero**. Anchors: `\bValidationEngine\b`, `defaultValidationEngine`, `\bvalidateFields\b` and the module path. For the bare `validate`, the anchor is an import clause from `@object-ui/core` that names it. Controls:
  - the same import-clause matcher finds `validateSchema` imported from `@object-ui/core` (`skills/objectui/guides/testing.md`);
  - nothing re-exports `@object-ui/core` wholesale;
  - the one namespace import of core (`nonGridRowCeiling.test.tsx`) reads two other names.
- `a78cd378c` (PR #10231) touched only the engine's two `toLocaleDateString` calls, its own new test and its changeset. That is maintenance and adds no production caller.
- `validation-engine-stays-unwired.test.ts` guards `ObjectValidationEngine` (`validators/`, #3110), which is a different module. It does not import `validation-engine.js`, it is unchanged, and it is green in the core run below.
- `buildValidationRules` lives in `@object-ui/fields`, not in core. This diff touches none of its files or its consumers.

## Pin: red on the base, green on the head, red under ablation

`validation-engine-retired-7659.test.ts` has two halves:

- **runtime:** none of the four names is an own key of `import * as corePublicEntry from '../../index.js'`. Firing controls: the key count is above 100, and `validateSchema` and `ObjectValidationEngine` are functions.
- **compile time:** `@ts-expect-error` on `import('../../index.js').ValidationEngine` and on the `typeof import(...)` of the three value names. The controls resolve `ObjectValidationEngine` and `validateSchema` through the same two query shapes. This half is compiled by `tsconfig.test.json`: `tsc --listFilesOnly` lists the file among the program's 173 core test files.

| leg | tree | vitest | `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` |
|---|---|---|---|
| red | base `bc97f9247` + pin | `Tests 1 failed, 1 passed (2)`, received `ValidationEngine`, `defaultValidationEngine`, `validate`, `validateFields` | exit 2, 4 × `TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` |
| green | head | `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 4 passed (4)` (pin + stays-unwired) | exit 0 |
| ablation | head `0b7251a3e` + base `validation-engine.ts` (blob `67b32db01` = base blob) + the export line put back | `Tests 1 failed, 1 passed (2)`, same four names | exit 2, same 4 × TS2578 |

Ablation mechanics:
- The export line was put back with `ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `b3e4e60a9` → `02acae16a`.
- Restore was proven by blob equality with HEAD (`b3e4e60a9`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The engine file was absent afterwards, and `git status --porcelain` was empty.
- ⚠️ The first ablation attempt was a no-op. Its replacement contained its anchor, so the tool refused it ("the anchor count moved 1 → 1") and took no reading. It was re-anchored on a span the replacement does not reproduce; only the second run is quoted.
- The pin reads `src` through a relative import. No `dist/` is on its resolution path, so no rebuild leg applies.

Built-entry reading, as an extra check: after the full build, `packages/core/dist/index.js` has 321 keys and none of the four names; `validateSchema` and `ObjectValidationEngine` are functions.

- the validation barrel's docblock opens with `Phase 3.5: Validation module`, not `Validation engine`.

- eslint on the two edited files: 0 errors; warnings 0 (`index.ts`) and 14 (`renderer.tsx`), unchanged.
- Serial: fresh `origin/main` `383a34f52` was fetched into a private ref. `git merge-tree --write-tree` is clean. Main has six commits since this branch's base `bc97f9247`; none touches any of this PR's 11 files, and none adds a reference to the four names.

## Acceptance notes

- `@object-ui/types` keeps the engine's type family: `AdvancedValidationSchema`, `AdvancedValidationRule`, `ValidationRuleType`, `ValidationFunction`, `AsyncValidationFunction`, `ValidationContext`, `AdvancedValidationResult` and `AdvancedValidationError`. At this change nothing in `packages/*/src`, `apps/` or `examples/` reads them; the engine was their only reader. The ruling covers the four core exports only, so the types stay. Retiring them would be a separate public-type removal (Clause-② again); the seat filed it as objectui#10719, and this PR does not touch it.
- The section banner above those types in `data-protocol.ts` still reads "Phase 3.5: ValidationSchema - Complete Validation Engine". I left it: it is a phase label and belongs to the same follow-up.
- Section 5 of `troubleshooting.md` also said the validation module "uses Zod schemas from `@object-ui/types`", but `schema-validator.ts` imports no Zod. That was the sentence naming "the validation engine", so it was rewritten with the rest of the paragraph.
- `ValidationContext.locale` (added by PR #10231, still pending in `9909-machine-locale-sweep.md`) stays declared with no reader in core. The dated note in that changeset says so.
